releaseNotes:
## Bookings and Contacts
- Separate the person arranging a booking from the guests staying. Uncheck "This person is also staying" and choose the main staying guest; rooms, meals and guest counts include attendees only.
- Keep spouses' separate names and emails within their shared family. Open the family card directly from the booking editor.
- Distinguish individual stays, family stays and bookings arranged. Emails from either linked spouse can find the family's booking without guessing between multiple bookings.
- Simplify the booking editor with Additional guests and expandable individual travel, dietary details and notes. Remove redundant Family members and Open full list shortcuts.
- Preserve participant identities when renaming, promoting or removing guests, including travel exceptions and historical snapshots. Confirm different travel before replacing it.
- Separate updating the booking contact from replacing the saved family/group. Preserve saved families when only some members attend.
- Preserve each spouse's contact identity in shared email threads and keep separate contact/attendee identities when importing details in Guest Inbox.

## Meals
- Shorten planner coffee labels to Coffee AM and Coffee PM, and align meal names, times, guest counts and cook fields consistently.

## Compatibility
- Keep existing bookings and older restored backups compatible. Validation protects incomplete older guest lists from accidental count changes.
